scope: PR #4294 current ten-connector batch; fixed-100 portfolio rollup is explicitly incomplete until the remaining batches are mapped
policy: A shared foundation gap is a blocking delivery record, never a disabled or N/A disposition. An operation or typed action with an open gap is not enabled and contributes zero toward a merge-ready verdict. Connector-specific workarounds are forbidden.

failing_validator_runtime_evidence: future fixed-100 validator is not implemented
source locks retain hashes and inventory but not raw source schemas; exact fixed REST descriptors are absent
28 typed actions do not resolve one-to-one to the pinned source operation inventory and are explicit unresolved source-identity gaps
foundation_gaps.missing_provider_neutral_capability: hash-matched source-contract import and fixed REST descriptor materialization

owning_issue_lane.owner: shared source-contract importer and fixed REST materializer

exact_closure_verification.exact_closure: For every fan-out row, a public artifact byte count and SHA-256 match its source lock; the generated exact descriptor carries source identity, fixed verb/path, all typed schemas, output policy, and an enabled generated CLI command. The future fixed-100 validator reports every row pass.

failing_validator_runtime_evidence: internal/connectors/commandrunner/runner.go:1391-1456 recognizes path., query., and body. targets but not header.
foundation_gaps.fanout_status: F0 must import exact header requirements before this gap can enumerate only the operations that require a caller-supplied non-auth header.

exact_closure_verification.exact_closure: The shared runtime validates only source-declared non-auth headers, rejects unknown or reserved headers before I/O, and the fixed-100 validator has passing header/path/query/body isolation tests for every imported header requirement.

failing_validator_runtime_evidence: 224 typed actions have nested object/array schemas
foundation_gaps.missing_provider_neutral_capability: declaration-bound structured nested object and array materialization

exact_closure_verification.exact_closure: #4305 materializes only closed schema-admitted nested object/array values, preserves fixed operation identity and approval payload binding, and every action fan-out row passes fixture/conformance plus the fixed-100 validator.

failing_validator_runtime_evidence: 120 source operations require bounded binary transfer materialization
current source audit separates binary transfer from REST writes
foundation_gaps.missing_provider_neutral_capability: direction-preserving bounded binary and multipart operation contract

owning_issue_lane.owner: shared bounded binary and multipart runtime

exact_closure_verification.exact_closure: The runtime validates declared media, local file target, byte bounds, direction, and mutation approval; each fan-out row passes binary download or upload fixture/conformance and no direction-collapse negative test passes.

failing_validator_runtime_evidence: internal/connectors/engine/bundle.go:2718-2732 validates rest_status but the loader registration is tracked by #4302
foundation_gaps.missing_provider_neutral_capability: registered rest_status and text_export operation kinds

exact_closure_verification.exact_closure: The loader accepts declared rest_status and text_export kinds, fixed status/text commands reach the real executor, and every fan-out row passes the fixed-100 validator.

failing_validator_runtime_evidence: PR #4304 persisted App and CLI dispatch integration is pending
491 typed actions cannot yet prove installed App and CLI destination dispatch
foundation_gaps.missing_provider_neutral_capability: persisted declarative typed destination application and CLI dispatch

owning_issue_lane.owner: persisted declarative destination App and CLI dispatch

exact_closure_verification.exact_closure: The final #4304 head is integrated and an installed App and CLI path selects each declared destination action without provider I/O during preflight; every action fan-out row passes the fixed-100 validator.

failing_validator_runtime_evidence: internal/connectors/sync_transport.go:147-150,431-456 resolves source binding by executor and stream instead of selected action
487 typed actions remain pending an exact action-specific mapping

exact_closure_verification.exact_closure: Source bindings resolve with the selected typed action or separately named exact destination; every pending action has its own exact input mapping, strategy, acknowledgement, delivery facts, and fixture/conformance proof.

failing_validator_runtime_evidence: 19 source operations have no provider-published bounded typed schema
raw JSON and generic transport are forbidden
foundation_gaps.missing_provider_neutral_capability: none: provider-published bounded schema or separately accepted bounded contract

owning_issue_lane.owner: provider schema publication or separately evidenced bounded contract

exact_closure_verification.exact_closure: The provider publishes an exact bounded request schema or a separately evidenced bounded contract is accepted; then the operation is imported and passes the same fixed-100 validator. It is never closed by raw JSON or a generic transport.

gap_fanout.note: Zero is not N/A or closed: F0 must import exact non-auth caller-supplied header requirements before exact provider-operation fanout can be enumerated.

portfolio.rule: The fixed-100 portfolio rollup becomes merge-eligible only when every batch emits this same deliverable and the executable fixed-100 validator reports per-connector and aggregate pass.

typed_action_membership.note: Join every listed stable gap id to foundation_gaps; unresolved source identity remains an explicit F0/F1 membership row and is not inferred.

machine_join_contract.fanout: For each stable gap id, foundation_gaps[].fanout is the deduplicated aggregate over the matching operation_gap_rows and action_gap_rows; membership rows enumerate every affected connector and provider operation.
